name: write a single statement sql file with no comments
definition: Produce a file containing exactly one SQL statement (SELECT or a WITH that yields one SELECT) terminated by exactly one semicolon, with no comment text and no leading side-effects.
failure_mode: Extra semicolons, comments, or multi-statement content is rejected outright.

name: detach and daemonize a long-running guest process
definition: Launch the emulator in the background so it keeps running after the controlling command returns, while leaving it alive for later verification.
failure_mode: Foregrounded or killed process means the VM disappears before verification.
